Tree Space of a Comparison of Phylogenies

Source: R/validation.R
plot_tree_space.Rd

Draws the tree-space figure of validate_phylogenies(): one panel per taxon set (A1 to A4) with the classical multidimensional scaling (MDS) of the pairwise distances among the trees, and one legend below. validate_phylogenies() calls it on the coordinates it computes; Tutorial 4 calls it on the coordinates of the reference run distributed in inst/extdata (phylocactus_table_tree_space.csv), so the figure is drawn without the reference trees or the checklist.

Usage

plot_tree_space(coordinates, metric = c("RF", "DPI"), tree_labels = NULL)

Arguments

coordinates

Data frame, or path to a CSV file, of tree-space coordinates as validate_phylogenies() writes them to SUPP_tree_space_coordinates.csv: columns analysis_id, analysis_label, tree, Dimension_1, Dimension_2 and metric.

metric

Character. Distance whose projection is drawn: "RF" (normalized Robinson-Foulds, the default) or "DPI" (Different Phylogenetic Information).

tree_labels

Named character vector or NULL. Legend labels, as in validate_phylogenies().

Value

A ggplot object (assembled with cowplot).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
coords <- system.file("extdata", "phylocactus_table_tree_space.csv", package = "PhyloCactus")
plot_tree_space(coords, metric = "RF")
} # }
